self.text: Hey there! I’m Clara, a design‑savvy Turkish gal in my mid‑30s who loves growing chillies in my spare time. Lately I’ve been looking for a language practice buddy, and I learn best when we tackle problems side‑by‑side, with the room in total silence so we can focus. I’m happiest meeting up in person – there’s nothing like a good conversation over a cup of tea. I’m usually free on Sunday afternoons or in the evenings during the week, so let’s pick a time that works for both of us and dive into some fun, quiet problem‑solving together!
